summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co Ltd reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 20, 2026. The filed excerpt details the passage of a resolution to increase authorized share capital from US$1,000,000 to US$100,000,000 via the creation of additional class A and class B ordinary shares, alongside amendments to the company's memorandum and articles of association. This corporate action is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, return of capital, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change events described. The filing is an ordinary report of internal corporate governance decisions that do not represent a transformative event or catalytic change requiring special-situations classification.
